summary.text: Eddy Rojas, a candidate with no party affiliation, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Florida's 28th Congressional District to Carlos Gimenez.
According to his campaign website, he came to Miami from Cuba and spent about 20 years building a service company.
He ran for Mayor of Miami-Dade County in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Rojas says on his campaign website that he came to Miami from Cuba and, over the past 20 years, built a service company from the ground up, starting by parking cars.
He ran in the nonpartisan August 20, 2024 primary for Mayor of Miami-Dade County and received 1.3% of the vote (3,609 votes); Daniella Levine Cava won the primary with 57.9%.
Rojas described his campaign values as family, faith and hard work.
He received 1.5% of the vote to Carlos Gimenez's 52.9%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
